name: La Mamounia
positioning: Palace hotel in Marrakech, a hotel since the early 1900s, set in gardens of roses, orange, olive and palm trees a few minutes from the Koutoubia Mosque and Jamaa el-Fna
best_for: Travelers who want to reach the Koutoubia Mosque, Jamaa el-Fna and the Medina in a few minutes
Food lovers drawn to Pierre Hermé's tea rooms and restaurants by Jean-Georges Vongerichten and Simone Zanoni
Families or friends wanting a suite with one to three bedrooms

facts.text: The hotel's transformation conceived in 2020 and 2023 was by designers Sanjit Manku and Patrick Jouin.
Condé Nast Traveler says La Mamounia was turned into a hotel in the early 1900s and that guests have included FDR and Churchill.
The restaurants include Asian cuisine curated by Jean-Georges Vongerichten, Italian by Simone Zanoni and Moroccan by Chef Rachid Agouray.
Pierre Hermé created exclusive Date and Earl Grey and Amlou macarons for La Mamounia.
Le Pavillon de la Piscine is the place for Sunday Brunch.
The kitchens draw fresh herbs and vegetables from the hotel's own kitchen garden.
The hotel has pools, a gym, tennis courts and gardens planted with roses, orange, olive and palm trees.
The hotel has a spa with hammams.
A vintage games room tucked away in the gardens has pinball and a pool table.
All bathrooms have a separate shower and bathtub, finished in marble and mashrabiya wooden latticework.
Suites have one to three bedrooms and are described as ideal for families and friends.
The Koutoubia Mosque, Place Jamaa el-Fna and the Medina are a few minutes from the hotel.

highlights.text: The Centenary Chandelier, a sculpture of light that pays homage to traditional Berber jewellery, greets guests as they walk through the doors.
The Riads have their own private entrances, pools and terraces.
Pierre Hermé's tea rooms are Le Menzeh in the heart of the gardens and one on the Andalusian patio.
A small cinema in blue velvet is hidden behind a sliding door.
Three large lanterns house the Oenotheque and two private lounges.

considerations.text: A minimum stay is required for certain periods, including Easter, All Saints and the end-of-year festivities.
The hotel is 6 km from Marrakech-Menara airport, about 10 minutes by car; the private airport transfer is included only for Exceptional Suite guests.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers.
